source: Rahu kalam / Yamagandam / Gulika slots: .claude/skills/telugu-jyotisha/reference.md §6 ('standard'). Durmuhurtham, Abhijit and the kalam slots were compared with Drik Panchang day pages for Hyderabad 2026-11-21 → 2026-12-20, Vijayawada 2027-04-07 and Dallas 2026-03-08 (read by automated agents on 2026-11-21, not yet checked by a person): all weekdays match, including Saturday's two Durmuhurtham slots and Tuesday's night slot. Thursday has no fixture row yet. Names (te/en) from design/handoff DayRibbon.
notes: Daytime = sunrise → sunset, night = sunset → next sunrise. A slot n of parts covers [(n−1)/parts, n/parts] of that span. Varjyam and Amrita kalam start ghati/60 of the way through their nakshatra and last lengthGhatis/60 of it (ghatis from nakshatras.json); assignBy 'start' = a window belongs to the panchangam day in which it starts (Drik Panchang convention), so a window crossing sunrise is listed once. 'verified' lists the weekdays compared against the reference; lock the rest with golden fixtures.
